question: A cloakroom gives each coat a numbered ticket. Two assistants pick random numbers from 1 to 1,000,000 for a busy evening. What must they do so that no two guests ever get the same number?
options: Write each number on a shared board when it is given, and pick again if it is already there
Trust that random numbers will not repeat
Each assistant checks their own list only
Use shorter numbers so they are easier to read
explanation: Random numbers can repeat, and two assistants checking only their own lists would both hand out the same number. One shared board that refuses a number already on it, like a unique key in the database, catches every repeat, and the assistant simply picks again.
